scope: The stock DELAY reads 0x400d1ce0 + 4 * (x >> 6) from a 508-entry table that ends at 0x400d24d0; at a slow tempo with a long TIME the index runs up to 16 bytes past the end, which are zero in 1.40C (measured under the port, upstream octabam #771). The overflow run now starts at 0x400d24e0, and a cave, unit or patch reaching 0x400d24d0..0x400d24df is refused at placement and in the finished image. Two fresh native builds of 236 selections (the ptable2 record's 128, FM Synth's native-comparison selections and the seven-effect menu proof), one with the base commit's build_bus.py and one with this one, in the pinned toolchain image with the static stock loader and the same module tree, so the builder is the only difference. Of 125 images the base builder makes, 86 are identical; 4 change, each one that wrote those 16 bytes before and keeps them stock now (its overflow code moves up by 16 bytes); 35 are newly refused, each with FM Synth 0.1.2, whose SRC page is pinned at 0x400d24d0. Of the base builder's 111 refusals, 9 with FM Synth now refuse earlier, at that page, and the rest are identical; nothing refused before builds now. No image the new builder makes writes the 16 bytes. delayTableTail is derived from each private image; no stock or image bytes are recorded. No hardware result is inferred.
